source_text: A 2025 WHO-commissioned study synthesizing data from over 50 countries affirmed that FGM impairs nearly all health domains—reproductive, sexual, urinary, and mental—without compensatory advantages, reinforcing that cultural rationales do not align with causal health outcomes.
